_provenance: S2.MONEY-QUANTITY.XB (2026-07-26, wave-3 money reconciliation — P1-68/P1-69 closure). Values below are what the REAL payment HTTP wire emits — backend/src/main/java/com/ax/template/authblueprint/payment/PaymentBodyMapper.toBody(Payment) (the Map<String,Object> body PaymentController actually returns), derived from Payment.java (BigDecimal amount, precision=19 scale=8) + PaymentService.scale()/CURRENCY_SCALES (KRW=0, USD=2) + PaymentBodyMapper.minorOrNull() (common/Money.toMinorUnits — the MAJOR→MINOR wire conversion). refundUsd is the LIVE RefundResponse body PaymentController#refund returns (RefundResponse.amount is a long of minor units). UNIFIED CONTRACT: every monetary value below is INTEGER MINOR UNITS — the same encoding contracts/payment-openapi.yaml#MoneyAmount declares (integer branch), MoneyDeserializer accepts on requests, and templates/L0/fork-receiver-kit/money.ts's parseMinor() consumes. The previous golden carried MAJOR-unit decimals (USD 10.99), which was neither branch of MoneyAmount's oneOf (P1-68) and made parseMinor silently misread whole-dollar amounts by 100x. Locked byte-equal by backend/src/test/java/com/ax/template/authblueprint/payment/MoneyContractParityTest.java (BE leg) and frontend/tests/money-contract-parity.vitest.ts (FE leg). See docs/BACKLOG.md P1-68/P1-69.

paymentUsd._note: a $10.99 USD payment. Stored as BigDecimal 10.99 (major); emitted as 1099 (minor) — the P1-68 closure. KRW legs are unchanged by the fix because KRW's minor unit IS its major unit (scale 0), which is exactly why the defect hid behind KRW-only integration tests.

paymentUsdTrailingZero._note: boundary: a USD 10.90 (scale-2) amount emits as 1090 minor units. The minor-unit conversion SUBSUMES the former PaymentBodyMapper.canonicalize() trailing-zero strip (which produced 10.9) — there is no trailing-zero question once the wire is an integer. RED-on-revert leg for common/Money.toMinorUnits in MoneyContractParityTest#paymentBody_usdTrailingZero_emitsMinorUnitsNotStrippedDecimal. BE-only golden entry; the FE leg does not consume it.

paymentKrwFullyRefunded._note: boundary: zero balance after a full refund (PAYMENT-RECON scenario)

paymentKrwLarge._note: boundary: large amount, still within Payment.amount's NUMERIC(19,8) 11-integer-digit capacity and within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER

refundUsd._note: RefundResponse.amount is ALWAYS positive per Refund.java (refunds are their own entity, never a negative delta on Payment.amount). This is the LIVE refund wire body (PaymentController#refund). $4.99 → 499 minor units.

syntheticBillingMinorNegative._note: NOT a payment-domain BE emission. Synthetic BILLING-domain-style integer minor-unit value used only to exercise parseMinor's negative-sign handling in isolation. Retained after the wave-3 unification because no payment amount is ever negative (a refund is its own positive row), so the negative branch has no payment-domain fixture.
